title: Kafka

fields.name: format
fields.description: Specify data format, options available: json, msgpack, raw.

fields.name: message_key
fields.description: Optional key to store the message

fields.name: message_key_field
fields.description: If set, the value of Message_Key_Field in the record will indicate the message key.

fields.name: timestamp_key
fields.description: Set the key to store the record timestamp

fields.name: timestamp_format
fields.description: Specify timestamp format, should be 'double', '[iso8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)' (seconds precision) or 'iso8601_ns' (fractional seconds precision)

fields.name: brokers
fields.description: Single or multiple list of Kafka Brokers, e.g: 192.168.1.3:9092, 192.168.1.4:9092.

fields.name: topics
fields.description: Single entry or list of topics separated by comma (,) that Fluent Bit will use to send messages to Kafka.

fields.name: topic_key
fields.description: If multiple Topics exists, the value of Topic_Key in the record will indicate the topic to use.

fields.name: dynamic_topic
fields.description: adds unknown topics (found in Topic_Key) to Topics.

fields.name: queue_full_retries
fields.description: Fluent Bit queues data into rdkafka library, if for some reason the underlying library cannot flush the records the queue might fills up blocking new addition of records.

fields.name: raw_log_key
fields.description: When using the raw format and set, the value of raw_log_key in the record will be send to kafka as the payload.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of [workers](/manual/3.2/administration/multithreading.md#outputs) to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: Kafka output plugin allows to ingest your records into an Apache Kafka service.
